blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Agent memory faces heterogeneous access needs: a single-hop question may require one piece of evidence, whereas a multi-hop question must combine evidence from multiple sources.
Predefined memory workflows cannot adapt to these varying needs.
Recent adaptive methods search or learn over memory components and their compositions, but the design space itself remains predefined.
We introduce MemCodex , a self-evolving hierarchical memory system that organizes experience into executable memory programs for summaries, relational knowledge, reusable skills, and latent memory.
Open-ended program evolution searches the open design space of layer programs by rewriting how each layer is constructed, indexed, retrieved, and routed, thereby adapting both within-layer implementations and cross-layer composition.
At query time, reads traverse the hierarchy from coarse to fine and stop once sufficient evidence is found, descending to the original history when needed.
We further develop MemArena , a unified runtime that places heterogeneous data and memory systems behind a common interface. MemCodex improves average task success by 10.1 % 10.1\% relative to the strongest adaptive-memory baseline, with 3.4 × 3.4\times fewer context tokens and 2.1 × 2.1\times faster inference.
blocks.zh:
代理内存面临不同的访问需求:单跳问题可能需要一个证据,而多跳问题必须结合来自多个来源的证据.
预定义的内存工作流程无法适应这些不同的需求.
最近的适应方法搜索或学习过内存组件及其组成,但设计空间本身仍然预设.
我们引入了MemCodex, 一个自我演变的层次记忆系统, 将经验组织成可执行的内存程序, 用于摘要、关系知识、可重复使用的技能和潜在的内存。
开放式程序进化通过重写每层的构造,索引,检索和路由,搜索层程序的开放式设计空间,从而同时适应层内执行和跨层组成.
在查询时,阅读从粗糙到细微的等级,一旦找到充分的证据就停止,必要时会降入原始历史。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Language agents [ 72 , 53 , 30 , 5 ] increasingly act over long horizons in web navigation [ 83 ] , software engineering [ 22 , 12 ] and computer use [ 68 , 54 ] , and self-evolve from experience [ 51 ] through reflection on failures [ 48 ] , skill accumulation [ 52 , 80 , 39 , 47 ] and code rewriting [ 76 ] .
Across sessions, much of this experience survives only in memory.
Hand-designed pipelines organize it through rolling summaries in systems such as MemoryBank and MemGPT [ 82 , 40 ] , facts and entity graphs [ 71 , 42 , 8 ] , skill stores [ 80 , 39 , 52 ] , or memory written into parameters or latent state [ 59 , 1 , 26 , 56 ] .
Yet these pipelines face access heterogeneity , because the memory organization a query needs depends on the query, the record and the task [ 70 , 35 , 17 ] .
This heterogeneity appears across query types, since single-hop questions need raw turns [ 11 ] , multi-hop questions need cross-session links [ 10 ] , temporal questions need dated events [ 9 ] , and repeated procedures need skills [ 62 ] .
Adaptive computation in reasoning shows the same pattern, where dynamic shortcuts spend depth only on the steps that need it [ 58 ] .
A hand-designed pipeline hard-codes both which organizations exist and the rule that chooses among them, and a study of fourteen memory systems [ 84 ] finds that no architecture dominates across tasks.
blocks.zh:
语言代理人[72,53,30,5]在网络导航[83],软件工程[22,12]和计算机使用[68,54]中越来越多地在长视野内行事,通过反思故障[48],技能积累[52,80,39,47]和代码重写[76]从经验中自我演化[51].
在整个会议中,这些经验大多仅存于记忆。
手工设计的管道通过下列系统中的滚动摘要加以组织:记忆银行和MemGPT[82,40]、事实和实体图[71,42,8]、技能库[80,39,52],或将内存写成参数或潜伏状态[59,1,26,56]。
然而这些管道面临访问的异质性,因为一个查询需要的内存组织取决于查询,记录和任务[70,35,17].
这种异质性出现在不同的查询类型中,因为单跳问题需要原始转折[11],多跳问题需要交叉会话链接[10],时间问题需要时间事件[9],重复程序需要技能[62].
推理中的适应性计算显示了相同的模式,其中动态快捷键仅花在需要它的步骤上[58].
手动设计的管道硬码既包括哪些组织存在,也包括其中选择的规则,对十四个内存系统的研究[84]发现,没有一个架构在任务之间占主导地位.

blocks.en:
Adaptive memory addresses this rigidity in two main directions.
One direction searches a predefined design space by selecting and composing modules for encoding, storage, retrieval, and management [ 6 , 35 , 74 ] .
The other, exemplified by Mem-alpha, learns policies for when and how to write, update, and retrieve memory [ 60 , 57 , 50 , 61 ] .
Despite their different forms, both directions must jointly determine how experience is organized into memory and how queries access it, since retrieval can only use structures created during writing.
As shown in MemCodex : Self-Programming Hierarchical Memory for Language Agents , this coupling places memory systems along two axes: memory organization and design search.
Among prior systems, only MemPro [ 34 ] opens the design itself to program search, but it evolves a single monolithic program over flat memory, without a hierarchy whose components can evolve and be accessed independently.
blocks.zh:
适应性记忆在两个主要方向解决这种刚性.
一个方向通过选择和编组编码、存储、检索和管理[6、35、74]模块,搜索预先定义的设计空间。
另一种以Mem-alpha为例,学习写作、更新和检索记忆的时间和方式的政策[60、57、50、61]。
尽管形式不同,但两个方向必须共同确定经验如何组织成内存,以及查询如何访问,因为检索只能使用写作过程中创建的结构.
正如MemCodex:语言代理的自编程层次记忆(Self-Programming Higharchical Memory)所示,这种组合将内存系统沿两个轴线放置:内存组织和设计搜索.
在之前的系统中,只有MemPro [34] 打开设计本身来程序搜索,但它在平面内存之上演化出单一的单体程序,没有等级结构,其组件可以进化并独立访问.

blocks.en:
We therefore introduce MemCodex , a hierarchical memory system whose layers are executable memory programs behind a fixed interface and runtime.
Program evolution adapts both the write and read code of individual layers and their cross-layer composition, that is, which layers are active and how items and reads pass between them.
Within this hierarchy, MemCodex organizes skill , graph , and summary above an append-only raw layer, with kv memory providing latent memory.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们引入了MemCodex,一种分级的内存系统,其层是固定接口和运行时间后可执行的内存程序.
程序演化既适应了单个层的书写和读取代码及其跨层组成,即哪些层是活跃的,以及项目和读取之间如何通过.
在这个等级中,MemCodex组织技能,图,和摘要上方的仅附件的生层,其中kv内存提供潜伏的内存.

blocks.en:
Inspired by the Darwin Gödel Machine [ 76 ] and HyperAgents [ 77 ] , which evolve an agent by rewriting its own code, we apply program evolution to this memory hierarchy.
At each round, a meta agent draws a parent from the archive and rewrites one method of one layer or toggles one layer.
Restricting each child to one change makes the effect of that change attributable.
An acceptance test then keeps changes that improve accuracy or reduce token use without degrading the other, and accuracy-only gains must additionally pass a one-sided McNemar test [ 37 ] .
Before this test, validity checks 𝒦 \mathcal{K} reject changes that break the memory constraints.
blocks.zh:
受达尔文·格德尔机器[76]和HyperAgents[77]的启发,通过重写自己的代码来演化一个代理,我们把程序演化应用到这个内存层次.
每回合,一个元代理从归档中抽取一个父体,并重写一个层的方法或切换一个层的方法.
将每个孩子限制在一个变化中,可以归因于这一变化的影响。
然后接受测试会保持提高精度或减少象征性使用而不贬低对方的修改,而精度唯一收益必须额外通过单面的麦克内马尔测试[37].
在这个测试之前, 检查有效性 K\ mathcal{K} 拒绝打破内存限制的更改 。

blocks.en:
The fixed interface exposes five methods in each layer, spanning both memory writing and reading.
On the write side, admit \mathrm{admit} filters candidates, index \mathrm{index} keeps a bounded active set, and propose \mathrm{propose} derives items for the layer above.
On the read side, score \mathrm{score} ranks candidates and route \mathrm{route} decides where the search proceeds next.
Reads move from coarse to fine layers, with route \mathrm{route} choosing Stop , Narrow , or Descend until sufficient evidence is found or the search reaches the raw history.
Because every stored item retains its exact source turns, the original evidence remains recoverable even after lossy summarization.

由于每个储存的物品都保留了确切的源头转折,原始证据即使在损失汇总之后仍然可以收回。

blocks.en:
To evaluate these mechanisms systematically across diverse sources, interaction formats, and evaluation protocols, we further develop MemArena , a heterogeneous agent-source evaluation suite with a unified data interface, access interface, and metric suite covering benchmarks such as LoCoMo [ 36 ] , LongMemEval (LME) [ 63 ] , and MemoryAgentBench (MAB) [ 15 ] .
It separates the memory system from the task agent, as capability-level evaluation dissociates what a language model knows from how it reasons [ 55 ] .
Under one protocol, MemArena spans seven sources, eleven baseline systems and two backbones, while each new source requires only one adapter.
Under this evaluation, MemCodex gains 5.6 5.6 average accuracy points over the strongest baseline with Qwen3.5-27B [ 41 ] and 3.6 3.6 with the API model GPT-5.4-mini, while reading 3.4 × 3.4\times fewer tokens and answering 2.1 × 2.1\times faster.
blocks.zh:
为了在各种来源、互动格式和评价协议中系统地评价这些机制,我们进一步开发了Memarena,这是一个具有统一数据接口、访问接口和计量套件的多种代理源评价套件,涵盖的基准包括LoCoMo[36]、LongMemEval(LME)[63]和MuryAgent Bench(MAB)[15]。
它将内存系统与任务代理区分开来,因为能力级评价将语言模型所知道的东西与它的原因分开[55].
根据一项协议,Memarena跨越7个源,11个基线系统和两个主干,而每个新源只需要一个适配器.
在本次评价下,MemCodex在最强基线上以Quen3.5-27B[41]和API模型GPT-5.4-mini的3.6-3.6得到5.65.6平均精确点,而读数3.4×3.4\时值减少,回答2.1×2.1\时值更快.

blocks.en:
Memory systems are reported on sources with different evidence formats, time representations and access protocols, so their results are difficult to compare directly. MemArena addresses this problem by placing heterogeneous sources and memory systems behind one data interface, one access interface and one metric suite, which allows any memory module to be evaluated with any task agent under a fixed backbone and judge.
It currently spans seven sources, eleven baseline systems and two backbones.
We release the suite together with its adapters and wrappers.

它目前跨越7个来源、11个基线系统和2个骨干。
我们把套房及其适配器和包装器一起放出来。

blocks.en:
We evaluate every system through MemArena on LoCoMo [ 36 ] , LongMemEval (S split) [ 63 ] , MemoryAgentBench (MAB) [ 15 ] and PersonaMind.
Following MemEvolve [ 74 ] and MemPro [ 34 ] , which evolve on a held-out slice of each benchmark, we take 20 percent of each benchmark’s questions as the evolve split Q Q .
We stratify Q Q by question category, such as single-hop, multi-hop, temporal and open-domain questions on LoCoMo, the five abilities of LongMemEval, the four competencies of MAB, and preference against procedure questions on PersonaMind.
We never read the test split during search.

We evaluate the open-weight Qwen3.5-27B [ 41 ] and the API model GPT-5.4-mini.
Per run, one backbone serves every system as task agent π \pi , writes derived items, and serves as meta agent ρ \rho at temperature 0.2 with one call per child.
Qwen3.5-27B reads text through the NL interface and Metis-27B [ 79 ] state kv memory through the KV interface, while GPT-5.4-mini uses only the NL interface.
Specifically, Qwen3.5-27B takes kv memory from Metis-27B, an open-weight memory foundation model that inserts fast-weight memory blocks into a frozen Qwen3.5-27B and updates them by test-time training in the forward pass with a gated delta rule, as in Titans [ 1 ] .
For each record, we run Metis-27B, extract its memory blocks’ key-value state, and inject it through the KV interface.
Because the two models share the frozen backbone, injection is native and requires no alignment.
Without weight access, GPT-5.4-mini has no latent memory.

The margin is smallest on LongMemEval ( + 4.5 +4.5 ), whose records already isolate evidence.

Table 2 tests the two claims behind MemCodex , the hierarchy with routed evidence and per-method evolution, using variants evolved under the same budget.

To isolate the evidence channel, variants place derived-item text in C C instead of source turns, or alongside them.
The evolution variants retain four layers but change how their programs are obtained.

Layer rewrites change one layer program per child as the slot-wise evolver of MemEvolve does, while program rewrites change every layer per child as MemPro does.

Per-method evolution outperforms matched variants of the three prior search lines on the same four-layer hierarchy. blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en:
Agent memory has moved from hand-designed stores toward structures and operations that adapt to the task [ 16 , 65 ] .
The first line of work hand-designs architectures as paged tiers, fact and entity stores, hierarchical or graph indexes, and latent or parametric memory [ 40 , 82 , 4 , 71 , 42 , 23 , 33 , 44 , 10 , 66 , 2 , 13 , 59 , 1 , 26 , 79 , 56 ] .
MemGPT [ 40 ] , for example, pages information between the context window and external storage following an operating-system model.
Beyond hand design, a second line instead learns policies that decide what to write, update, consolidate, forget, or retrieve [ 60 , 50 , 61 , 21 , 75 , 25 , 3 , 29 , 73 , 57 ] .
Mem- α \alpha [ 60 ] , for instance, trains its write and update operations with reinforcement learning.
More recently, memory design itself has become a search problem [ 6 , 35 , 74 , 69 , 32 ] .
Closest to our setting, MemPro [ 34 ] evolves the entire construction and retrieval pipeline as one program over a version tree of runnable implementations.
By contrast, MemCodex evolves the layer programs and hierarchy composition one method at a time, while every derived item keeps its exact source turns, so evidence remains recoverable throughout evolution.

代理内存已经从手工设计的商店转移到适应任务的结构和操作[16,65].
第1行的手设计架构作为页刻的层次,事实和实体存储,层次或图表索引,以及潜在或参数存储[40,82,4,71,42,23,33,44,10,66,2,13,59,1,26,79,56].
MemGPT [40] 例如,上下文窗口和外部存储之间的页面信息遵循操作系统模式.
在手设计之外,第二行则学习决定如何写、更新、合并、忘记或检索[60、50、61、21、75、25、3、29、73、57]的政策。
例如,Mem - α\alpha [60] 训练它的写作和更新操作,进行强化学习。
最近,内存设计本身已成为一个搜索问题[6,35,74,69,32].
最接近于我们的设定,MemPro [34] 将整个构建和检索管道发展成一个程序,在可运行执行的版本树之上.
相比之下,MemCodex一次演化出层程序和层次组成一个方法,而每个衍生项目保持其准确的源转动,因此在整个演化过程中证据仍然可以恢复.

blocks.en:
More broadly, program search lets agents improve their own code or the harness around a model under empirical evaluation.
One line automates agent and harness design [ 14 , 24 , 28 , 78 , 64 ] .
ADAS [ 14 ] , for instance, lets a meta agent program new agents and archive its discoveries.
Another line extends this approach to self-referential agents that rewrite their own code [ 45 ] and retain variants through empirical validation rather than the proof demanded by the Gödel machine [ 76 , 77 , 19 , 31 , 49 ] , while acceptance rules for such changes are studied directly [ 46 ] .
The Darwin Gödel Machine [ 76 ] exemplifies this line by growing an archive of self-modifying coding agents validated on benchmarks.
HyperAgents [ 77 ] further merge the task agent and meta agent into one editable program.
By contrast, in MemCodex the search unit is one method of one memory layer behind a fixed interface, and a child enters the archive only after validity checks and an acceptance test.

例如,ADAS[14]允许一个元代理程序新的代理并存档其发现.
另一行将此方法延伸至通过经验验证而不是格德尔机要求的证明来改写自己的代码[45]和保留变体的自我优惠代理人[76,77,19,31,49],同时直接研究这些修改的接受规则.
达尔文·格德尔机器[76]通过增加一个在基准上验证的自修改编码剂的档案,来说明这条线.
HyperAgents [77] 进一步将任务代理和元代理合并为一个可编辑的程序.
相比之下,在MemCodex中,搜索单元是固定接口后一个内存层的一种方法,一个孩子只有在有效性检查和接受测试后才能进入档案.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We propose MemCodex , a self-evolving hierarchical memory system that organizes experience into executable layer programs for summaries, relations, skills and latent memory.
It evolves each layer through attributable per-method edits behind fixed interfaces and keeps every derived item’s exact source turns.
Reads traverse the hierarchy from coarse to fine and descend to source turns as needed.
Through MemArena , it outperforms hand-designed and adaptive memory systems across benchmarks and backbones at lower cost.
The experiments credit evidence preservation with the initial lead and per-method evolution with most of the rest, while the acceptance test carries evolve-split gains to the test split and evolved architectures remain task-specific yet transfer in part.
Next, we will evolve the runtime and the layer set themselves under record-disjoint deployment.
blocks.zh:
我们提出MemCodex,一种自我演变的层次记忆系统,将经验组织成可执行的层程序,用于总结,关系,技能和潜伏的记忆.
它通过可归属的按方法在固定界面后进行编辑来演化每个层,并保持每个衍生项目的确切源转.
读到从粗细到细细的层次,然后依需要从源头转向源头。
通过MemArena,它以较低的成本超越了跨基准和主干线的手工设计和适应性记忆系统。
实验信用证据的保存与最初的铅和与大部分其他方法的按方法演化,而验收测试带进进分化的增益到测试分解,进化的架构仍然是任务特定,但部分转移.
接下来,我们将演化出运行时间,层层将自己设定在记录不同步的部署下.
